title: Chapter 96
text:
Han Xiao extended the barrel of his sniper rifle out of the window and fired a high-explosive bullet. It accurately hit one of Rose Militant's off-road vehicles. The vehicle was engulfed in flames. However, the desert off-road vehicles were specially designed to withstand high temperatures. The high-explosive bullet's lethality was limited. Han Xiao observed the situation and decisively switched to shuttle-type bullets. He fired at the bulletproof glass of Rose Militant's vehicle, causing snowflake-like cracks to appear.

"Surround them!" The Ghostly Fox Squad immediately turned around, and two vehicles surrounded them.

"Where will the ambush be?"

Since he knew that there was a tiger in the mountain, Han Xiao was naturally on high alert. Suddenly, he controlled the magnetic armor to cover his face and blocked a sniper bullet that was aimed at his forehead. He looked up and saw a new enemy SUV appear from the side. There was an unfamiliar enemy holding a sniper rifle in the back seat. To be able to fire such a precise shot on a high-speed vehicle, there was a thirty percent chance that the enemy was also a Mechanic, sixty percent that the enemy was a sniper, and the last ten percent chance that the enemy was just a lucky shot.

The previous shot was fired by Code Three. Seeing that it did not work, he was slightly shocked. He said in a low voice, "The target has a special defense. I'm not sure if it's a superpower or a machine."

Han Xiao guessed that there was more to the ambush. He patted the back of the front seat and said, "Let's go quickly. Don't slow down. Go to the designated location."

Antonio skillfully switched gears and stepped on the accelerator. The car drifted and fled in another direction.

Suddenly, another off-road vehicle appeared in their direction. It seemed to have been waiting for a long time. This time, it was Code Five. He was holding a rocket launcher and fired at them.

The rocket rapidly approached them with a trail of flames.

Antonio's expression changed slightly. He quickly turned the steering wheel, and the car swerved ninety degrees. The rocket grazed the back of the car and hit the desert.

The deafening sound of the explosion filled the air with yellow sand.

The shockwave hit the rear of the car. The rear of the car lifted thirty degrees and fell heavily. Han Xiao, who was in the back seat, was jolted. His butt hurt.

"Tsk, we dodged it." Code Five was surprised by the driver's quick reaction. He did not stop what he was doing and quickly reloaded.

The four off-road vehicles occupied three directions, forming an encirclement. Antonio could only run in the last direction, but it happened to be the direction where Han Xiao had set up the trap.

"He has nowhere to run." Number Three narrowed his eyes. "Number Nine is waiting for him in front with The Thorns."

Thorns was an armored vehicle modified by Su Li. It had powerful firepower, ample horsepower, and thick armor. It had both the attack and defense of a tank and the speed of an off-road vehicle.

Last night, E 'Nine had been monitoring Han Xiao's whereabouts. The three killers had set up an ambush with E' Nine as the final insurance. He had steered Thorns in the direction where Han Xiao had set up the ambush. He had even confirmed the approximate location of the ambush, so there was no way he would fall for it. He had deliberately waited in the direction where Han Xiao was heading, so that when Han Xiao had hope, he would be plunged into despair!

"He's already dead," E said quietly.

The chase was filled with sparks and explosions. A rain of bullets and rockets chased after Han Xiao's vehicle. Han Xiao fired back repeatedly, barely hindering the pursuit of the four off-road vehicles. The firepower of the Scarlet Falcon sniper rifle and the shuttle-type penetrating bullets was quite a threat to the people from Rose Militant. However, his vehicle was currently fleeing in a panic. Coupled with the distractions of Code Three and Code Five, his accuracy was greatly reduced.

"Vroom —"

A unique roar of the engine was heard. It sounded like the roar of a tiger.

Han Xiaoxin's heart skipped a beat. He quickly looked ahead.

A modified vehicle was blocking his path. Its exterior armor was thick and covered with spikes, making it look like a porcupine. There were several gun barrels on both sides of the vehicle. Judging from the caliber, they should be grenade launchers and mini missile launchers. There was also a four-barreled heavy machine gun on top of the vehicle. No, that caliber should be called a heavy machine gun. It was more than enough to be used as an airborne weapon.

The Thorns!

This vehicle was blocking the last direction, forming a tight encirclement with the other four vehicles. There was no way to escape!

"We definitely won't be able to withstand the firepower of that thing!" Antonio's expression changed.

There was a wolf in front and a tiger behind. All directions were blocked. It was as if they were in a desperate situation.

"Drive to the south. Don't worry about the firepower of that vehicle. I'll deal with it," Han Xiao said in a low voice.

The enemy in the south was Code Three. He only had one sniper rifle, so he was the least threatening.

Antonio could only choose to believe in Han Xiao. He quickly turned around and rammed into Code Three.

"Too late."

Code Three's expression was cold. He was about to control the Thorns' cannon to blow Han Xiao's off-road vehicle into the sky when he saw Han Xiao turn around and fire a shot at him. The bullet hit the glass and burst into a bright flash.

Code Three was so shocked that his eyes started tearing up. He closed them subconsciously.

Dazzling Light Bullet!

Boom! Boom! Boom! The heavy machine gun on Thorns spewed out thick flames and smoke. The bullet missed its target and hit a dozen meters away from Han Xiao's off-road vehicle.

"Sh * t! Why did Old Nine miss?" Code Three was shocked. He hurriedly asked the driver to stop Han Xiao's vehicle.

Antonio was not afraid at all. He stepped on the accelerator and rammed into the side of Code Three's off-road vehicle.

Both vehicles shook. In the end, it was Antonio who chose the right angle to crash into the vehicle that opened a path for them to escape the encirclement.

"Chase!"

Code Three was a little annoyed that all his efforts were in vain at the crucial moment. However, he calmed down after looking at the situation.

It did not matter. They still had the upper hand. Han Xiao had deviated from the direction of the trap and was panicking. With the power and firepower of Thorns, it was only a matter of time before they caught up with him and destroyed his vehicle!

Han Xiao looked behind him through the window. The fleet of Rose Militant was chasing closely behind them. They were less than 200 meters away, and both parties were traveling at more than 160 kilometers per hour. Thorns was still firing non-stop, and the rear of the vehicle that was chasing after him was blasted into a cloud of dust. The effect of the Light Flash Bomb on Code Three had not subsided yet. His eyes were sore and swollen, and his vision was blurry. He could not see clearly at all.

Han Xiao lowered his head and looked at the coordinate radar. He did not panic at all. He said in a deep voice, "Antonio, activate the nitrogen acceleration in 48 seconds!"

"47 … 30 … 16 … 3, 2, 1!"

When the time was up, Antonio immediately opened the small cover beside the gear, revealing the nitrogen acceleration button. He pressed it hard.

Blue flames spewed out of the off-road vehicle's exhaust pipe. The vehicle's speed instantly increased, and the distance between them increased rapidly. The two people in the vehicle were pressed against the back of their seats and could not move at all.

"A futile struggle." Code Three did not care. The nitrogen acceleration would end sooner or later. It was just a temporary lifespan. Thorns would catch up with them sooner or later, and they would be blasted into the sky with a wave of firepower.

Soon, the distance between them increased to 400 meters. The effect of the nitrogen acceleration disappeared.

"They're slowing down."

Code Five reloaded a new rocket. He stood up from the sunroof and aimed from afar.

At this moment, his vehicle braked suddenly. The sudden momentum caused Code Five to fall into the backseat.

"What the hell?"

Code Five roared. He saw that the driver was sweating profusely, but the vehicle did not respond. His heart sank. He turned around and looked out of the window. All the off-road vehicles of Rose Militant had stopped. Thorns was the same. All of them had lost their power.

"All the vehicles are paralyzed!"

"What happened?"

The members of Rose Militant were shocked. Their vehicles had stopped working, and they were like lambs waiting to be slaughtered in the desert. Han Xiao's off-road vehicle stopped at a distance.

Ghostly Fox wanted to call for help from the base, but she realized that her communicator had stopped working. She shouted, "This is the effect of the EMP!"

"Impossible! This is not the direction where he set the trap! "Code Five was shocked.

Ghostly Fox's heart turned cold when she thought about Dorothy's death.

"Run!"

The next moment, a high-explosive sniper bullet was fired from afar. The target was a patch of sand under Code Three's feet. The landmines buried in the ground were detonated. This time, it was not only the Poison Deflagration Mine, but also the real explosive mine taken from Fabian's warehouse.

The deafening sound of the explosion was incessant, and the dazzling flames soared into the sky, leaving behind an orange-red glow on Han Xiao's retina. The hundred-meter radius around the Rose Militant was completely filled with flames and explosions, and no one could be seen.
